children: Core & Main, Inc. reported first-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $2.15B, net income of $144M and diluted EPS of $0.77, all higher versus the prior-year quarter as the company benefited from a mix of volume, price and acquisitions.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Core & Main, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share (“EPS”)”.
Revenue growth was driven by a mix of higher volume, price and acquisitions; six-month results also showed modest gains.
Municipal end-market remains the largest (~44%); gains were led by fire protection and smart utility products.
Network expansion exceeded 370 branches, and the company completed strategic tuck‑ins including Pioneer Supply and Canada Waterworks in fiscal 2025.
Gross margin initiatives and disciplined purchasing improved gross profit rate and operating income despite seasonal construction cycles and market volatility.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
